spreadsheetEditor.maxEditSizeMB.description: CSV and TSV files up to this size open for editing. Larger ones (up to spreadsheetEditor.maxFileSizeMB) open read-only. Free up to 512 MB. With Zovo Pro up to 2,000 MB.

spreadsheetEditor.maxFileSizeMB.description: CSV and TSV files above this size are not opened here; open them as text instead. Free up to 1,024 MB. With Zovo Pro up to 2,000 MB.

spreadsheetEditor.maxExcelSizeMB.description: Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm) up to this size open for editing. Free up to 40 MB. With Zovo Pro up to 200 MB.

spreadsheetEditor.maxExcelCells.description: Excel workbooks with more cells than this (all sheets together) are not opened, to protect memory.

spreadsheetEditor.maxCopyRows.description: Copy at most this many rows to the clipboard at once.

spreadsheetEditor.autoReload.description: Read the file again when it changes on disk and you have no unsaved edits. With unsaved edits, nothing is reloaded: a note shows, and saving asks before it overwrites the newer file.

spreadsheetEditor.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after 2 files opened without an error, in 2 sessions at least 4 hours apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. Nothing is sent anywhere.

spreadsheetEditor.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free viewers and Sponsor links in the editor's status bar. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Spreadsheet Editor
walkthroughs.description: Edit CSV and Excel files as a spreadsheet, with real undo and save.

steps.title: Open a CSV or Excel file
steps.description:
.xlsx files open in Spreadsheet Editor when you click them. For a CSV or TSV file, click the table icon in the editor title, or right-click it and pick "Open in Spreadsheet Editor".
[Make it the default for CSV](command:spreadsheetEditor.makeDefaultForCsv)

steps.title: Edit, paste and undo
steps.description: Type to change a cell, Enter to go down, Tab to go right. Paste a block from Excel or Google Sheets. Right-click for rows and columns. Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+S saves; the tab shows a dot while there are unsaved edits.

media.altText: A CSV file open in Spreadsheet Editor with an edited cell highlighted.

steps.title: Find, replace and filter
steps.description:
Ctrl+F opens find and replace, with match case, regex and whole-cell options. Type in the filter box, or a SQL condition such as price > 10 AND city LIKE 'Par%'.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22spreadsheetEditor%22%5D)

steps.title: Files that go with this one
steps.description:
If your project also has PDF files or spreadsheets and CSV files, these free Zovo extensions open them. A link opens the extension page, and you choose there whether to install it.
[PDF Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.pdf-viewer-dark%22%5D)
[XLSX and CSV Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.table-viewer-vscode%22%5D)
